Transport Documents

Biên Nhận Bến Cảng

A document issued by a carrier or terminal operator acknowledging receipt of goods at the dock or port prior to shipment, confirming transfer of custody.

Quick answer: A document issued by a carrier or terminal operator acknowledging receipt of goods at the dock or port prior to shipment, confirming transfer of custody.

Why it matters

Biên Nhận Bến Cảng matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

What is Biên Nhận Bến Cảng?

In this glossary, Biên Nhận Bến Cảng refers to: A document issued by a carrier or terminal operator acknowledging receipt of goods at the dock or port prior to shipment, confirming transfer of custody.

How is Biên Nhận Bến Cảng used in logistics?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A document issued by a carrier or terminal operator acknowledging receipt of goods at the dock or port prior to shipment, confirming transfer of custody.

Operational example

The exporter presented the dock receipt as proof that the cargo was delivered to the shipping terminal before loading.
